text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa completed the race with a 
brilliant record.

Seeing that she shows no signs of fatigue, 
the Trainer recommends that she enter the 
Japan Derby.

Gaining the precious opportunity to 
compete against her peers, El Condor Pasa 
felt even more energized.

Special Week was also eagerly looking 
forward to facing her. ...Both of their 
spirits burned brightly toward that 
fateful day.
